subject: Renewal: upgrade to Premium SLA + burst capacity proposal
messages:
From: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <l.park@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Cc: Marcus Yuen <m.yuen@novahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Jul 2028 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: upgrade to Premium SLA + burst capacity proposal

Hi Lisa / NovaHealth procurement team,

Hope you’re well — our records show your Redwood subscription (account RDW-2371) is up for renewal in mid-August. Based on your growth over the last year and the increased latency sensitivity on the CareQuery chat flows, I wanted to propose an optional upgrade ahead of renewal:

- Premium SLA add-on (99.95% uptime + 50ms p95 latency objective for the chat endpoint)
- Dedicated burst pool: additional reserved GPUs for traffic spikes (up to 30% above baseline for up to 6 hours/day)
- 24/7 Priority Support (direct war room + named CSM)

I attached a short renewal-summary.pdf that outlines the pricing uplift and a suggested rollout (canary -> full). Can we schedule 30 minutes this week to run through tradeoffs and timing?

If you prefer, we can also keep existing terms and add the burst pool as a temporary overage commitment for the next quarter.

Thanks — I’ll loop in our CS/Delivery and Legal leads for the technical and contract questions once we have alignment.

Best,
Diego Fernández
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: renewal-summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Lisa Park <l.park@novahealth.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Yuen <m.yuen@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: upgrade to Premium SLA + burst capacity proposal

Diego,

Thanks for the note. We are definitely evaluating a higher support tier and lower latency targets for the CareQuery product. A few clarifying questions before we book time:

1) Can you confirm the incremental monthly cost for the Premium SLA + burst pool vs. what we pay today? Please provide a 12-month and 24-month commit option.
2) Is the 50ms p95 latency objective measured at the API edge (across your hosted regions) or only within the dedicated pools?
3) We will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and network isolation details for procurement. Also confirm whether the burst pool can be isolated to a VPC if we move to a Private deployment later this year.

Marcus (cc) wants the finance-friendly summary in advance — can you send numbers and the SOC2 doc?

Best,
Lisa Park
Head of Platform Operations, NovaHealth
From: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Park <l.park@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal: upgrade to Premium SLA + burst capacity proposal

Monica / Jordan — forwarding Lisa's reply. Top asks: price delta for 12/24 mo, definition of 50ms p95 (edge vs dedicated), SOC2 evidence, VPC isolation for burst pool.

Ask 1 (Pricing): can you propose a clean 12/24 month renewal package that includes: base renewal + Premium SLA + burst pool (30% capacity for spikes), and an option for an initial 3-month trial of the burst pool billed as usage if they want to test first. Put the numbers in two columns (12m / 24m) and include any volume discount thresholds.

Ask 2 (Delivery & Tech): what’s the impact on lead time for enabling the burst pool and achieving the latency SLO in production? Any special infra changes?

Ask 3 (Compliance): include SOC2 artifact link and a short note on Private deployment/VPC isolation feasibility.

Target to reply to NovaHealth by EOD Wednesday so we can lock a meeting for Thursday.

Thanks — Diego
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Park <l.park@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Wed, 04 Jul 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal: upgrade to Premium SLA + burst capacity proposal

Diego — draft pricing and delivery notes below. I also attached capacity_plan.xlsx with the GPU sizing.

Pricing (monthly incremental over current):
- 12m commit: Premium SLA + burst pool (30%): $18,500/mo incremental
- 24m commit: Premium SLA + burst pool (30%): $15,750/mo incremental (10% term discount)
- 3-month trial: enable burst pool as metered usage at $0.40 per extra GPU-hour (no long-term commitment)

Technical / SLO notes:
- 50ms p95 is achievable at the API edge for most routings if we route CareQuery traffic to the dedicated burst pool plus edge caching; will require pinned instance families (A100/RTX class) and our optimized kernels.
- Lead time: 6–8 weeks to provision dedicated burst pool and validate p95 at scale (can accelerate to 3–4 weeks with a 30% expedite fee and priority scheduling).
- VPC isolation: feasible in Private deployments; for hosted accounts we offer traffic segmentation and private peering for dedicated pools — VPC attachment requires Private deployment contract plus a short infra runbook.

Compliance:
- SOC 2 Type II report: https://redwood-secure.example.com/soc2/2027-report.pdf
- Audit logs and retention policies meet NovaHealth baseline; we can propose additional retention as a paid add-on.

Next steps: I recommend the 24m commit if they want both cost predictability and the full support/playbook. I’ll prep a short runbook for onboarding and an initial test plan we can share during the meeting.

—Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: capacity_plan.xlsx (XLSX, 85KB)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Park <l.park@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Thu, 05 Jul 2028 09:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal: upgrade to Premium SLA + burst capacity proposal

Quick contract points:
- SLA: we can commit to 99.95% uptime. The latency objective will be captured as a best-effort SLO with a remediation credit bucket tied to observed p95 misses (typical approach: service credits, not a financial penalty tied to infrastructure choice).
- Term: offer both 12- and 24-month addenda with explicit provisioning lead times (6–8 weeks standard; expedite fee option).
- VPC/private-hosting clause: include an optional amendment that converts hosted dedicated pools to Private deployment with a one-time migration fee and 30-day rollback window.

I’ll draft the SLA addendum and link it via DocuSign for signature. Expect the draft by EOD Friday.

Jordan Blake
Director, Sales Operations & Contracts, Redwood Inference
Attachment: sla-draft.docx (DOCX, 45KB)
From: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <l.park@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Yuen <m.yuen@novahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: upgrade to Premium SLA + burst capacity proposal

Lisa / Marcus — thanks for the quick turn. Attached are the proposed numbers and artifacts: renewal-summary.pdf (overview), capacity_plan.xlsx (sizing + lead times), sla-draft.docx (contract language).

Summary proposal (high level):
- Option A (24m commit): Premium SLA + 30% burst pool: $15,750/mo incremental; 99.95% uptime; latency objective 50ms p95 with dedicated routing and caching; 6–8 week provisioning.
- Option B (12m commit): Premium SLA + 30% burst pool: $18,500/mo incremental; same SLOs; 6–8 week provisioning.
- Option C (trial-first): Keep current term; enable burst pool as metered usage for 90 days at $0.40/extra GPU-hour; if they convert within 90 days, we credit the metered spend toward the first invoice of the new term.

Compliance: SOC2 Type II report link and network isolation notes included. If NovaHealth needs VPC isolation, we should aim for a Private deployment kickoff in Q4 and will provide a migration runbook.

Next step proposals:
1) Book a 45-minute technical + procurement meeting Thursday 7/12 — I’ll bring Monica for runbook + Jordan for the SLA walk.
2) If they agree to 24m, I’ll send the DocuSign link with the SLA addendum pre-attached for signature the same day.

Would Thursday morning (10:00 AM PT) work?

Best,
Diego Fernández
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: renewal-summary.pdf, capacity_plan.xlsx, sla-draft.docx
